extensions.scope: Landing page only: lmslocal-web/src/app/page.tsx (route /) and lmslocal-web/src/components/landing/results/. Every other screen follows docs/design-system.md (the pools coupon).

display.purpose: The hero LAST MAN STANDING only. Double height: scaleY(2) from the top-left, size min(68px, fit-to-width) using VT323's 0.42em advance.

headline.purpose: Page banner titles, double height, min(52px, fit-to-width) with 120px reserved for the page number (84px on a phone).

numeral.purpose: The STILL STANDING count, tabular figures, yellow.

feed.purpose: The results feed: min(40px, width / (36 x 0.42em)); on a phone min(36px, width / (26 x 0.42em)).

title.purpose: Sub-headings within a page and button labels (30px on a phone).

readout.purpose: Hero offer lines, dotted-leader ledgers (25px on a phone), download rows, banner page numbers.

label.purpose: Header row, index, fastext keys, ledger and slider labels, listings, text links, footer links (24-28px).

body-lede.purpose: Opening paragraph under a banner, max 40em (19px on a phone).

body.purpose: Running copy, max 42em (17px on a phone).

body-small.purpose: Fine print, listing details and download blurbs, in dim ink.

motion.name: teleprinter
motion.value: steps(n, end), 30ms per character, 320ms between results, first line at 600ms
motion.purpose: Live feed lines type in with a 0.5ch print head that shows only while typing.

motion.name: flash
motion.purpose: The block cursor on YOUR PICK. On, off, on; never a fade.

motion.name: count-drop
motion.purpose: The STILL STANDING count falling as each OUT figure finishes typing; driven by animationend, not timers.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Typing, flash, button transitions and smooth scroll all off; the feed shows the finished round and the final count.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Also where the fastext keys shorten to one word.

narrative.overview:
The page is a broadcast text service on a Saturday afternoon. Scores type in one character at a time, each knocking thousands out of a national game, and a giant count of who is still standing drops as they land. Everything else is laid out the way a teletext service lays out its pages: numbered pages with solid colour banners, an index whose entries are page numbers, dotted-leader ledgers for figures, and four coloured keys fixed along the bottom of the screen.

It is dense, flat and loud on a black ground. Colour is never decoration: each of the five broadcast colours has one fixed meaning across the whole page, and appears either as text on black or as a solid block carrying black text. Depth, emphasis and state all come from fills and inversion, never from shadow, blur, gradient or rounded corners. Motion is the teleprinter's: even, stepped, on-or-off.

Figures that are invented to show the mechanism (the national game is not built yet) carry a visible SAMPLE tag. That tag is part of the world, not a disclaimer bolted on.
keyCharacteristics: Phosphor-black screen (`screen-black`) with off-white `ink` text; the browser's own scrollbar and selection follow it.
Five broadcast colours with fixed roles; solid blocks always carry black text, except blue, which carries ink.
VT323 in capitals for anything a line or shorter; Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono for anything longer.
Double-height headings, drawn twice as tall at the same width and sized to fit without wrapping.
Every section is a numbered page (P100 to P600), reached from the index and the fastext bar.
Square corners, ruled lines, dotted leaders. No shadows.

rules.name: The Fixed Roles Rule
rules.body: Yellow is the national game and the primary action, cyan is organisers and clubs, green is through and the rules, red is out and the join code, blue is a neutral banner, white is text. A colour is chosen by what the thing *is*, and never reused for anything else; a new section takes the colour of its audience, or blue if it has none.

rules.name: The Two Fills Rule
rules.body: Colour appears in exactly two ways: as text on black, or as a solid block with black text on it (blue alone carries ink). No tints, no transparency, no gradients.

rules.name: The One Line Rule
rules.body: Anything a line or shorter is VT323 in capitals; anything longer is Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono in sentence case. VT323 tires the eye in a paragraph.

rules.name: The Double Height Rule
rules.body: Headings are teletext double height: the glyphs are drawn with `transform: scaleY(2)` from the top-left at their normal width, inside a box reserved at `2em × lines`. Each heading declares its longest line in characters (`--chars`) and a ceiling (`--max`); its size is the smaller of the ceiling and what fits the screen width, using VT323's advance of 0.42em per character (`--adv`). A double-height heading never wraps. Banners reserve 120px (84px on a phone) for their page number.

rules.name: The Page Number Rule
rules.body: Every section is a numbered page, and the banner, the index and the fastext keys all point at the same number in the same colour. A new section gets a page number, an index entry in its role colour, and a banner — not an unnumbered block.

rules.name: The Inversion Rule
rules.body: State is shown by swapping fills, the way a selected row on a text service lights up: hover turns a row, link or solid button to an ink block with black text; an outlined cyan button fills cyan; a fastext key fills with its own colour. Nothing lifts, glows or moves.

dos: **Do** pick a colour by role — yellow national game and primary action, cyan organisers, green through and rules, red out and the code, blue neutral banners — and keep it on every element of that thing (banner, index number, fastext key, button).
**Do** set anything a line or shorter in VT323 capitals and anything longer in Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono.
**Do** draw headings at double height with a declared character count, sized to fit without wrapping.
**Do** show hover and selection by inverting to a solid fill with black text.
**Do** give every new section a page number, an index entry and a banner.
**Do** put figures in dotted-leader ledgers, with values in their role colour.
**Do** tag any invented or not-yet-live figure with a visible SAMPLE block.
**Do** flash on and off with `step-end` and type with `steps()`; switch both off under reduced motion and show the finished state instead.
donts: **Don't** apply this world outside the landing page, or bring the pools-coupon tokens (`src/lib/design.ts`, the Tailwind colour tokens) into it.
**Don't** use a colour outside its role, such as cyan on a national-game action or red as plain emphasis.
**Don't** add shadows, gradients, blur, transparency or rounded corners.
**Don't** set paragraphs in VT323, or let a double-height heading wrap.
**Don't** fade a flash or a cursor; broadcast text is on or off.
**Don't** put light text on yellow, cyan, green or red blocks; they carry black.
